text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Due to scheduled track maintenance, I 
planned on starting training 
earlier than 
usual... or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: One! Two! Three!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... It still feels like I'm not hitting that last turn well. Once more, then...
choice_data_list: It's almost time for training, but...
It's almost time for training, but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I know, I know. Don't be so 
impatient. No one likes being 
rushed.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just let me focus for a bit longer. I 
stumbled in the middle of my last 
winning 
concert...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you didn't see it? Well then, my 
recovery must've been perfect.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But it doesn't matter if people noticed or 
not—a failure's a failure. I 
won't allow 
myself to make the same mistake twice.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's what it means to be first-rate.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So please, let me go through it one more 
time. It's fine if we push 
training a bit later.
choice_data_list: Got it, one more time then.
Got it, one more time then.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Once more until I'm satisfied with 
my performance.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hm? Did I stutter? I don't think so.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Did you really think I would 
leave a flaw as-is? I won't 
move on until it's 
perfect!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you the honor of starting the 
music. Together, we will push my 
dancing 
skills to the highest level!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's start training. Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? Gosh, we're fine. 
Relax a little bit.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I know the schedule for this 
course. I'm positive we've got 
ample time 
to spare.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, that's enough talk for now! Hurry 
up and get ready for 
practice already!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...It's my policy to always give it my all, 
whether it's dancing or 
training. Everything 
must be perfect—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding dong...

text_block_list.name: School Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Training time has ended. The course will 
now undergo scheduled 
maintenance. 
Students, please collect your belongings 
and exit 
quickly.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Gasp.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... A-as if I'd forget something so 
crucial! And besides, it's not like 
I have to 
practice at school. I can go run somewhere 
else.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, you can leave. Training alone isn't a 
big deal anyway. I'll be 
fine by myself!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: All right, shoo—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But I'm sure you have other things on your 
to-do list today. You don't 
have to come 
with—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
W-well, you better get ready to stay for 
hours and hours because I'm 
going to keep 
running until I'm satisfied!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! That's the energy I'm looking 
for! I hope you're prepared!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the sun slips underneath the horizon, I 
keep King Halo company 
while she trains 
to her heart's content.
